coptic: Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ: ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

translations.english: Blessed are You O Lord God of our fathers, and exceedingly to be blessed and exalted above all forever.
translations.arabic: مبارك أنت أيها الرب إله أبائنا، ومتزايد بركة ومتزايد علواً إلى الآباد.

ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

translations.english: Blessed is Your holy name and Your glory, and exceedingly to be blessed and exalted above all forever.
translations.arabic: مبارك إسم مجدك القدوس، ومتزايد بركة ومتزايد علواً إلى الآباد.

transliterations.english: Efesmaroout enje piran ethowab ente pekoou: eferhowo esmaroout eferhowo chisi sha ni-eneh.

stanzas.coptic: Ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲱ̀ⲟⲩ:
ϥ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ϥ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

sung.english: Blessed is the holy name of Your glory, and exceedingly to be blessed, and exalted above all forever.

coptic: Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

translations.english: Blessed are You in the holy temple of Your glory, and exceedingly to be blessed and exalted above all forever.
translations.arabic: مبارك أنت في هيكل مجدك المقدس، ومتزايد بركة ومتزايد علواً إلى الآباد.

translations.english: Blessed are You who beholds the depths and sits upon the Cherubim, and exceedingly to be blessed and exalted above all forever.
translations.arabic: مبارك أنت أيها الناظر إلى الأعماق الجالس على الشاروبيم، ومتزايد بركة ومتزايد علواً إلى الآباد.

transliterations.english: Ekesmaroout fee-ethnav eninoun efhemsi hijen Nisherouvim: ekerhowo esmaroout ekerhowo chisi sha ni-eneh.

coptic: Ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲕ̀ⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

translations.english: Blessed are You in the firmament of heaven, and exceedingly to be blessed and exalted above all forever.
translations.arabic: مبارك أنت في فلك السماء، ومتزايد بركة ومتزايد علواً إلى الآباد.

transliterations.english: Ekesmaroout khen pi-estere-oma ente etfe: ekerhowo esmaroout ekerhowo chisi sha ni-eneh.

translations.english: Bless the Lord O you works of the Lord, praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.

sung.english: Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord, praise Him and exalt Him, above all forever.

translations.english: Bless the Lord all you angels of the Lord, praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.

translations.english: Bless the Lord O sun and moon, praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.
translations.arabic: باركا الرب أيتها الشمس والقمر، سبحاه وزيداه علواً إلى الآباد.

translations.english: Bless the Lord all you stars of heaven, praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.

transliterations.english: Esmou e-epshois nisiou teerou ente etfe: hos erof arihowo chasf sha ni-eneh.

translations.english: Bless the Lord O you rain and dew, praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.

translations.english: Bless the Lord O you clouds and winds, praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.
